 Is Anirudh Ravichander Too Busy To Ignore Even Badshah?
 Music lovers have been eagerly waiting for Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film King.
 By:   Priya Chowdhary Nuthalapti   |   31 Oct 2026 12:00 AM IST Share: X Music lovers have been eagerly waiting for Shah Rukh Khan's upcoming film King. One of the biggest attractions of the movie was expected to be its music especially after Anirudh Ravichander delivered a successful album for Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan. However latest reports about Anirudh's exit from the music team have surprised fans.
 According to reports, Anirudh Ravichander will no longer handle the complete music album and background score for King. Interestingly, he has reportedly contributed a special theme track for the film. The remaining music work has now been given to popular composer duo Sachin-Jigar.
 Reports suggest that scheduling issues are the main reason behind this development. Anirudh is currently busy with several commitments in the South Indian film industry. Due to his packed schedule, he reportedly found it difficult to manage the complete music work for King's production.
 The decision was reportedly taken mutually after discussions between Anirudh, director Siddharth Anand and the production team. Sachin-Jigar will now take care of the remaining songs and background score. They are also expected to work on the theme track for the film.
 However this development has raised an interesting question among movie lovers. Is Anirudh Ravichander so busy that he cannot make time for a Shah Rukh Khan film? This is really making everyone suprised. 
 Meanwhile expectations surrounding King are increasing. The film is scheduled to release worldwide on December 24, 2026. Shah Rukh Khan's birthday on November 2 is also creating excitement among fans. Reports suggest that the makers may release the first song featuring Arijit Singh around that time.
